title: SEER: Enhancing Chain-of-Thought Code Generation through Self-Exploring Deep Reasoning
summary: The original SEER pipeline enhances code generation by guiding LLMs through self-exploring deep reasoning chains, where the model iteratively elaborates and refines its chain-of-thought before producing the final solution on HumanEval, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench.

This reproduction replaces the self-exploring reasoning chain with single-call code generation prompts (Prompt A: zero-shot, Prompt B: chain-of-thought) over sampled problems from all three benchmarks.
